# Kaede Project

> Kaede Project is an IT and AI consulting and development company: an IT and AI partner for businesses of every size. It advises businesses on what to build and then builds it: websites, AI assistants and agents, automations, CRM systems and custom platforms.

Kaede Project is available in English and Spanish. Spanish pricing is listed in Colombian pesos (COP), English pricing in US dollars (USD).

## Pages

- [Kaede Project (English)](https://www.kaedeproject.com/en): services, pricing, process, selected projects and FAQ.
- [Kaede Project (Español)](https://www.kaedeproject.com/es): servicios, precios, proceso, proyectos destacados y preguntas frecuentes.

## Services

- IT & AI Consulting: deciding which processes to automate, where AI adds value and which tools to connect, before building.
- Web Development: landing pages, corporate websites, e-commerce, custom websites and web platforms.
- Artificial Intelligence: AI consulting, AI assistants, AI agents, AI integrations, content workflows and business-specific AI tools.
- Automation: workflow automation, lead routing, notifications, data synchronization, marketing and sales automation.
- CRM & Integrations: CRM implementation and customization, lead pipelines, API integrations and business dashboards.

## Pricing (English site)

- Landing Page: 300 USD
- Corporate Website: 450 USD
- E-commerce: 600 USD
- Custom Web Solution: quoted per project

## Precios (sitio en español)

- Landing Page: 900.000 COP
- Sitio Corporativo: 1'400.000 COP
- E-commerce: 1'900.000 COP
- Solución Web a Medida: cotización individual según el alcance

These are the published plans for each language, not currency conversions. Platforms, portals and advanced integrations require a project quote.

## Frequently asked questions / Preguntas frecuentes

- Website pricing: the fixed-price plans are listed above in USD and COP. Custom platforms, portals and advanced integrations are quoted individually.
- IT and AI consulting: Kaede Project helps identify which processes to automate, where AI adds value and which tools to connect, then implements the solution.
- Website types: landing pages, corporate websites, online stores and custom platforms, including client portals, membership sites and internal systems.
- Automation: lead routing, notifications, data synchronization, marketing and sales follow-ups, and internal operations using the business's existing tools.
- AI integration: assistants, agents, integrations with existing tools, content workflows and business-specific data processing.
- CRM: implementation, customization, lead pipelines, API integrations and business dashboards.
- Starting a project: contact Kaede Project on WhatsApp or use the quick diagnostic on the website. The team works through Discover, Define, Design, Build, Connect and Launch, with scope and timeline agreed in a quote before starting.

The full FAQs are available at https://www.kaedeproject.com/en#faq and https://www.kaedeproject.com/es#faq.
